entries.question: Cardiology o p d appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment for the Cardiology OPD at KGMU, you can use any of the following methods:

**1. Online Booking (Recommended)**
*   Visit the official website: [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in)
*   Select "Uttar Pradesh" as the state and "King George's Medical University" as the hospital.
*   Click "New Appointment," select the **Cardiology** department, choose your preferred date, and pay the ₹50 fee online.

**2. Mobile App**
*   Download the **ABHA** or **ORS** app from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register with your mobile number and follow the same steps as the online portal to book your slot.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the format: `APPOINTMENT <Your Name>` to **8887019134**. 
*   You will receive a confirmation for your appointment.

**4. Walk-in Registration**
*   You can visit the hospital in person, but please note that **pre-booking is strongly recommended** to avoid long wait times.
*   **Requirements:** You must bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to receive the registration OTP.
*   **Fee:** ₹50 (payable at the counter).
*   **Timings:** Counters are open Monday–Friday (9:00 AM–1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM–12:00 PM). Counters close at 1:00 PM sharp.

**Important Notes:**
*   **Outside-city patients:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please ensure you carry a valid referral letter for the Cardiology department.
*   **Emergency:** If this is a medical emergency, please proceed directly to the Trauma Centre (Gate 14). Cardiology emergencies are typically stabilized at the Trauma Centre and then referred to the LARI Cardiology department.
*   **Contact for Help:** You can call the KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

entries.question: MSc nursing me kya kya dacument lgta h
entries.answer:
M.Sc. Nursing में प्रवेश के लिए आमतौर पर निम्नलिखित दस्तावेजों (documents) की आवश्यकता होती है। कृपया ध्यान दें कि काउंसलिंग या एडमिशन के समय KGMU द्वारा जारी आधिकारिक सूचना (Prospectus) में दी गई सूची ही अंतिम मानी जाएगी:

1. **शैक्षणिक दस्तावेज (Academic Documents):**
   - 10वीं और 12वीं की मार्कशीट और सर्टिफिकेट।
   - B.Sc. Nursing (Basic/Post-Basic) की सभी वर्षों की मार्कशीट।
   - B.Sc. Nursing की डिग्री सर्टिफिकेट या प्रोविजनल सर्टिफिकेट।
   - इंटर्नशिप पूरा होने का प्रमाण पत्र (Internship Completion Certificate)।

2. **पंजीकरण (Registration):**
   - राज्य नर्सिंग काउंसिल (State Nursing Council) द्वारा जारी वैध रजिस्ट्रेशन सर्टिफिकेट (RN & RM)।

3. **पहचान और अन्य प्रमाण पत्र:**
   - आधार कार्ड (Aadhaar Card)।
   - यदि लागू हो, तो जाति प्रमाण पत्र (Caste Certificate - OBC/SC/ST) जो उत्तर प्रदेश सरकार के प्रारूप में हो।
   - ईडब्ल्यूएस (EWS) प्रमाण पत्र (यदि लागू हो)।
   - अधिवास प्रमाण पत्र (Domicile Certificate of U.P.)।

4. **अन्य आवश्यक दस्तावेज:**
   - प्रवेश परीक्षा का एडमिट कार्ड और रैंक लेटर (Rank Letter)।
   - पासपोर्ट साइज फोटो।
   - यदि आप कहीं कार्यरत हैं, तो 'नो ऑब्जेक्शन सर्टिफिकेट' (NOC) या अनुभव प्रमाण पत्र (Experience Certificate) – जैसा कि प्रोस्पेक्टस में मांगा गया हो।

**महत्वपूर्ण सलाह:**
* प्रवेश प्रक्रिया शुरू होने पर KGMU द्वारा जारी **"Information Brochure"** को ध्यान से पढ़ें, क्योंकि उसमें दस्तावेजों की सटीक सूची और फॉर्मेट की जानकारी दी होती है।
* आप अपडेट के लिए [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) पर "Admissions" सेक्शन चेक करते रहें।

क्या आप किसी विशेष वर्ष के प्रवेश के बारे में जानना चाहते हैं?

entries.question: Opd apartment
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at KGMU, please note that online registration is mandatory. You can use any of the following methods:

### **Booking Methods**
*   **Online Portal:** Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in). Select Uttar Pradesh as the state and KGMU as the hospital to book your slot.
*   **Mobile App:** Download the "ABHA" or "Health Care" app from the KGMU Play Store and follow the same booking steps.
*   **SMS Service:** Send an SMS with the text **"APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>"** to **8887019134**.
*   **On-Site (Walk-in):** You can visit the registration counters. You must bring your **Aadhaar card** and an active mobile number to receive an OTP for registration.

### **Important OPD Information**
*   **Fee:** There is a flat fee of **₹50** for the OPD slip (payable via all booking methods).
*   **Timings:**
    *   Monday–Friday: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
    *   Saturday: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM
    *   **Closed on Sundays.**
*   **Note:** The ticket/parchi counter closes at **1:00 PM sharp**, so it is strongly recommended to arrive early or pre-book your appointment to avoid long wait times.
*   **Outside-city patients:** If you are visiting from outside Lucknow, please ensure you carry a valid referral letter for the specific department you are visiting.

**Medical Safety:** I am not qualified to provide medical advice. If you have specific health concerns, please consult a doctor at the KGMU OPD. For your safety, please avoid sharing personal details like your phone number or Aadhaar number in this chat.
